findings.label: Phoneless gate not scoped to federated sessions
findings.description: The `if (!data.phone)` branch at the top of fetchProfile fires for every caller (Google sign-in, traditional login line 583, session restore line 185), so a phoneless non-Google user is routed into the federated-basic 'Completa tu Teléfono' screen and the PUT /profile update path instead of the OTP/wizard they previously got. The screen degrades gracefully (Google name field hidden without googleData) so it does not crash. Suggested fix: gate the branch on a federated signal (state.googleData / otpContext === 'federated') or fall through to the wizard when there is no Google context. Non-blocking because normal traditional users already have a phone and are unaffected.
